hook_candidates.spoken: You share an AI chat by link. Do you know who else can read it?
hook_candidates.on_screen: Chat shared. Who else can read it?

hook_candidates.spoken: The link only goes to one person, so it stays private? Not according to OpenAI.
Shared ChatGPT links have no expiry date you can set.
hook_candidates.on_screen: No expiry date for the link

hook_candidates.spoken: A shared chat with customer details is readable by anyone who has the link.
hook_candidates.on_screen: Customer details in a chat link?

hook_candidates.spoken: Wednesday, 2:05 p.m. You're about to share a chat full of customer details.
hook_candidates.on_screen: WED 14:05 · Share a chat with customer data?
hook_candidates.visual: clock, the chat window arrives as a paper card, the line with customer details is marked

beats.spoken: Wednesday, 2:05 p.m. You've drafted payment reminders with ChatGPT, with names, addresses and amounts. For the owner, you click Share.
Recipient: only the owner. The link: a long random string. The account: your personal one. Looks private. But OpenAI says that on personal accounts, anyone with the link can view the chat.

fact.text: Anyone who has the link can view the shared chat.

beats.spoken: What do you do? A: Send the link, it's only going to her. B: Send the link and delete it later. C: Take the customer details out first, then share. Remember your choice.

options.text: Send it, it's only going to her
Send it, delete the link later

beats.spoken: Let's play out B. The owner forwards the link to your accountant. You can't set an expiry date. And when you delete it later: anyone who already continued the chat keeps a copy.

The right answer is C. OpenAI itself says: don't put financial details or other sensitive personal information in shared content. A and B don't change what's inside: the link shows everything, and a copy can stay.
